name: gambrel_roof
description: Gambrel roof (折线屋顶): two pitches per slope — steep lower (~63°, stacked stair pairs) and shallow upper (~27°, stair+top-slab treads) — the barn / Dutch-Colonial profile that doubles attic volume. Every top slab is carried by a hidden support stair below it (floating slabs fail validation). Ridge sealed, optional gambrel-end wall fill. All states derived.
when_to_use: Barns, farmhouses, Dutch-Colonial and rustic builds that need a roomy attic on a mid-size footprint. origin = the wall footprint's north-west corner, y = first layer ABOVE the top wall block. Ridge along `axis`. lower_rise+2*upper_rise must close the span ({S-1, S}, S = (span+2*overhang)//2) — the script errors and lists the legal combos if it doesn't. DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED BY THE SCRIPT — never hand-edit (禁止手改方向状态).
use_for: 谷仓/农舍/荷兰殖民式主屋顶;中等体量(进深 8-14)要阁楼空间时替代 gable

origin.notes: 墙 footprint 西北角;y = 墙顶上一层

width.notes: 墙 footprint 沿 x(屋脊方向,axis=x 时)

depth.notes: 墙 footprint 沿 z(坡跨方向,axis=x 时)

lower_rise.notes: 下陡段层数(每层 2 高 1 收,双楼梯叠放)

upper_rise.notes: 上缓段层数(每层 1 高 2 收,楼梯+上半砖)

axis.notes: 屋脊方向;山墙面朝另一轴

material.notes: 坡面;缓段半砖由它推导(_stairs->_slab)

ridge.notes: 屋脊处加一排盖缝半砖

end_fill.notes: 山墙端面填充材料;空=开口山墙

pitfalls: lower_rise+2*upper_rise 必须落在 {S-1, S}(S=(坡跨+2*overhang)//2),报错会列出本跨度的全部合法 [lower,upper] 组合 —— 别硬填,改参数重跑
下陡段是'双楼梯叠放'(正放+倒放同柱,63°):上面那格必须 half=top,改成 bottom 就出现台阶缺口
上缓段每格上半砖(type=top)正下方都有一格隐藏承重楼梯 —— 删了就是漏顶洞(slab hole),验收器必抓
折线感来自分段直线:MC 尺度别追求真曲线(wiki:半径<6m 的'曲线'看着只是乱坡)
进深太小(<8)做不出两段坡,直接用 gable_roof;只有一段坡需求的也别硬凑 gambrel
end_fill 山墙是折线剖面的梯形三角,别拿 gable 的纯三角去对
example: python patterns/gambrel_roof.py --params '{"origin":[100,83,100],"width":9,"depth":11,"material":"minecraft:dark_oak_stairs"}' --out gambrel.json && python patterns/gambrel_roof.py --params '{"origin":[100,83,120],"width":7,"depth":8,"lower_rise":1,"upper_rise":2,"end_fill":"minecraft:oak_planks"}' --out gambrel2.json
